Name: Ancient Fruit Banned from Seed Maker
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34384/34384-1749855392-1190772129.png[/img][/center][/u]
[list]
[*]Prevents Ancient Fruit being processed into Ancient Seeds in the Seed Maker.
[*]As a result, makes it a lot more difficult to fill your greenhouse with [s]money-printing machines[/s] Ancient Fruit.
[*]Does [b]not[/b] prevent Ancient Seeds from appearing at random from other processed fruits/veg.
[/list]
This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Mini-Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34384/34384-1749855397-2125804846.png[/img][/center][/u]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34384/34384-1749855405-1401856511.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Ancient Fruits Banned from Seed Maker[/b] to your mods folder.
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do!
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34384/34384-1749855411-234804696.png[/img][/center]
No compatibility issues noted as of v1.0.1.

[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34384/34384-1749855418-1050200589.png[/img][/center][/u]
